data.one_liner: Widgets for customizable number transition and counter animations in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre‑built and highly modifiable widgets to animate numeric values with sliding and fading digit transitions. Supports both implicit and explicit animation styles.
use_when: You need animated counters or odometer‑style number displays in a UI
You want fine‑grained control over digit animation progress
avoid_when: You require complex data visualizations beyond simple number changes
You need a full‑featured UI kit rather than a single animation widget
strengths: Supports both implicit and explicit animation APIs
weaknesses: Focused only on number animations, no broader widget set

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: General purpose animation library that can also animate numbers

alternatives.name: animate_do
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple declarative animation helpers, including number tweening
